subject.title: Feature request: fallback model chain for compaction and LCM summaryModel

question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.defaults.compaction.fallbacks` as a core public config surface now, and should Lossless summary-model fallback live in the Lossless plugin or a generic context-engine SDK seam?
rationale: The requested behavior is useful but changes public config and provider/auth routing, and the Lossless portion depends on owner-boundary/API direction rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve embedded core fallback plus plugin-owned Lossless
options.body: Add a narrow opt-in embedded compaction fallback config, then keep Lossless/LCM summary fallback in the owning plugin unless a missing SDK seam is proven.

options.title: Keep all fallback policy plugin-owned
options.body: Reject new core config and require compaction providers or context-engine plugins to own their own fallback behavior through existing or newly approved plugin APIs.

options.title: Defer until a broader context-engine API design
options.body: Leave the issue open but pause implementation until maintainers design one generic summary-model fallback contract for embedded and context-engine compaction.

recommendation.title: Approve embedded core fallback plus plugin-owned Lossless
recommendation.body: Add a narrow opt-in embedded compaction fallback config, then keep Lossless/LCM summary fallback in the owning plugin unless a missing SDK seam is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent compaction fallback and context-engine ownership work is closest to the API boundary this decision must settle.
